system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Perception

One of your senses is highly developed, allowing you to spot what others might miss.

Choose one from sight, sound, touch, taste, or smell.

  • When making a Perception check using your chosen sense, you gain bonus dice equal to your Training in Perception.

  • The GM may allow you to make Perception checks that others cannot, such as to smell poison in food, or to see things beyond other’s sight.

You may take this ability multiple times, choosing a different sense each time.
